summary: Hope's Last Day 4/4 — the XENOMORPHS bestiary tail: Stage III: Chestburster (stat block + prose + 4-row D6 attack table) and Stage IV: Drone (stat block + prose + Silent Assassin bullet + 6-row D6 attack table). Built by structural substitution on the English source so every tag, style attribute, img src, NBSP layout cell and the single ev-content-link anchor survive byte-for-byte; only text nodes changed. Two h3 headings translated and given explicit id= carrying the Foundry non-strict slug of the original English text (stage-iii:-chestburster, stage-iv:-drone). Mechanic vocabulary pulled from lang/cn.json (速度/生命值/机动/侦察/护甲等级/对火护甲/酸血飞溅/近战/破甲/恐慌检定/压力/近距离/伤害) and from the settled glossary (基础骰子/潜行模式/区域/班/重伤/压力等级/异形). Combat "turn" rendered 回合 per ST-J03.cn's established 轮/节/班/回合 split, not the time-unit 节. Three life-cycle caste names have no Chinese precedent and are flagged as gaps: Chestburster=破胸体, Drone=工蜂异形, Imp=小鬼异形 — each used consistently throughout the unit. The generator script is kept in sync and reproduces the delivered file byte-identically (sha256 4b9090292e0ed291…).

open_issues: UPSTREAM BROKEN DEEP LINK — needs a controller decision, and it is the one thing in this unit I could not fix from inside my own byte range. Two links target this page's Stage headings by hash: ST-J08 line 264 and ST-J26 both emit data-hash="stage-iii" with the label 'Stage III: Chestburster', and ST-J08 line 54 / ST-J22 emit data-hash="stage-i" for 'Stage I: Ovomorph (Egg)'. Neither hash can ever resolve: Foundry builds the page TOC with String#slugify({strict:false}), which turns those headings into 'stage-iii:-chestburster' and 'stage-i:-ovomorph-(egg)' — exactly the form corerules uses in its own data-hash values. So both links already scroll to the top in the shipped ENGLISH pack; this is not a translation regression. I followed the gate and stamped the true English slug (id="stage-iii:-chestburster"), which keeps parity with English and keeps a mechanical 'id == slugify(english heading)' check green. If the controller would rather FIX it in the Chinese pack, the correct edit is in the LINKING units, not here: change data-hash="stage-iii" -> "stage-iii:-chestburster" in ST-J08/ST-J26 and data-hash="stage-i" -> "stage-i:-ovomorph-(egg)" in ST-J08/ST-J22. Do NOT instead set my heading id to the bare 'stage-iii' — that would silently diverge from the slug rule and invite a later 'fix' back.

STRAY '>' PRESERVED — the Chestburster paragraph ends 'organ transformation. >' in the English, a stray literal '>' with no markup role. It renders as a visible '>' mid-page. I kept it byte-for-byte rather than silently dropping a visible character. If the controller wants upstream typos cleaned, this is one; the fix is deleting ' >' on line 43 of the .cn.html.

CROSS-CHUNK CONSISTENCY, chunks 3/4 and 4/4 — ST-J09 (not yet translated) holds the Stage I and Stage II stat blocks that share my label rows. When it lands, its Facehugger block must use the same renderings I used here: 速度 / 生命值 / 机动 / 侦察 / 护甲等级 / 酸血飞溅, and its 'Armor Level 1 (0 Vs Fire)' must read 1（对火护甲 0）to match my 2（对火护甲 1）. Its two h3 headings need id="stage-i:-ovomorph-(egg)" and id="stage-ii:-facehugger".

COMBAT TURN vs TIME-UNIT TURN — 'on its next turn' in the Ready To Kill row is a combat slot, not the 5–10 minute time unit. I rendered it 回合, following ST-J03.cn which already writes 你所行动的位置称为你的回合 and 异形在它的下一个回合移动. The settled vocabulary list maps Turn -> 节, which is the TIME unit; applying 节 here would be wrong. Worth pinning as a domain split so a later 'terminology unification' pass does not overwrite it.

REGISTER — nothing in this unit is class="evblockquoteCenter" read-aloud prose in the narrative sense; the two evblockquoteCenter blocks are stat tables, and the two evexamplebox blocks are D6 attack tables (rules examples, not read-aloud). I therefore wrote the attack rows for a GM reading them out at the table — short clauses, verb-first, horror diction (破膛而出 / 喷得四处飞溅 / 怔立在原地 / 一记骇人的重击) — while keeping every number and mechanic term flat and scannable.
